title: Eltako - Product and test inspector
description: Search for a device, a product or a test run and look at its raw telegrams: what was sent, what came back, how the values developed.

list.name: search
list.label: Search (address or name)
list.description: Free text, matches a part of the address or the device name. Leave empty for all.

list.name: payload
list.label: Data payload contains
list.description: Part of the raw data bytes, e.g. '70' or '00-50'. Leave empty for all.

list.name: value
list.label: Decoded value
list.description: Which decoded EEP field to plot (temperature, humidity, state, ...)

targets.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${device:json}[0] == "$__all" or contains(value: r.device_name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${address:json}[0] == "$__all" or contains(value: r.address, set: ${address:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${eep:json}[0] == "$__all" or contains(value: r.eep, set: ${eep:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "$search" == "" or strings.containsStr(v: r.address, substr: "$search")
                       or (exists r.device_name and strings.containsStr(v: r.device_name, substr: "$search")))
  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Raw telegrams (newest first)
panels.description: Exactly what went over the air/bus: direction, message type, the raw data bytes and the status byte. This is the table to read after a test run.

targets.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and (r._field == "data" or r._field == "status" or r._field == "rp_count" or r._field == "rssi_dbm" or r._field == "raw"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${device:json}[0] == "$__all" or contains(value: r.device_name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${address:json}[0] == "$__all" or contains(value: r.address, set: ${address:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${eep:json}[0] == "$__all" or contains(value: r.eep, set: ${eep:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "$search" == "" or strings.containsStr(v: r.address, substr: "$search")
                       or (exists r.device_name and strings.containsStr(v: r.device_name, substr: "$search")))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "$payload" == "" or (exists r.data and strings.containsStr(v: r.data, substr: "$payload")))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 500)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "direction", "address", "device_name", "msg_type", "eep",
                    "data", "raw", "status", "rp_count", "rssi_dbm", "gateway_id", "decode_error"])

panels.title: Distinct data payloads
panels.description: Which distinct payloads did this product send? A rocker switch shows a handful of values, a sensor a wide spread - a quick way to spot a stuck device.

targets.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r._field == "data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${device:json}[0] == "$__all" or contains(value: r.device_name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${address:json}[0] == "$__all" or contains(value: r.address, set: ${address:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "$payload" == "" or strings.containsStr(v: r._value, substr: "$payload"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with payload: r._value }))
  |> group(columns: ["payload", "address", "device_name", "msg_type"])
  |> reduce(identity: {occurrences: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({occurrences: accumulator.occurrences + 1}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["occurrences"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 200)
  |> keep(columns: ["payload", "address", "device_name", "msg_type", "occurrences"])
